# `uuid`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
uuid()
```

Returns an universally unique identifier (UUID) string. The value is returned as a canonical UUID 36-character string.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `misc_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [0, 1] |
| Deterministic | no |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT uuid();
```

Result:

```text
46707d92-02f4-4817-8116-a4c3b23e6266
```
